svg.title: Private coordinates are indexed by insertion, not by distinct physical position or by generator name. Thus repeated occurrences in one slot share its mark, while different slots retain independent marks. The same readout on the horizontal potential copy uses the transported Gaussian law and coefficient maps, giving precisely the original Xi,a. Its bilinear second moment is PT19, with i2 = −1 and no conjugation. This preserves finite-regulator same-slot terms rather than setting them to zero. For an insertion polynomial Qi and a fixed physical coordinate vector zi = (kT h,xi,aZ)a, the private integral has the exact finite polynomial form
